title: Second and third conditionals: free practice
instructionEs: Escribe, transforma y corrige las frases.

items.text: If I ___ (to live) in London, I ___ (to visit) museums every weekend.
items.explanationEs: Condicional 2: if + pasado simple (lived) y would + verbo (would visit).

items.text: If they ___ (to leave) earlier, they ___ (to catch) the train.
items.explanationEs: Condicional 3: if + had + participio (had left) y would have + participio (caught).

items.text: She ___ (not / be) so tired if she went to bed earlier.
items.explanationEs: Resultado imaginario en el presente: wouldn't + verbo.
Pregunta: would pasa delante del sujeto.

items.source: We would have won the match.
answers: We wouldn't have won the match.
We’d not have won the match.

items.sentence: If I had more money, I will buy a new car.
items.explanationEs: Una situación imaginaria (no tengo más dinero) pide would, no will.
